title: Feature-led burn ratio and pricing experiments (FY27 primers)
content:
Purpose:
Quick exploratory workbook to compare FY27 headcount and cost outcomes for a feature-led GTM tilt (higher personalization + embedding-heavy flows) across 4 pricing scenarios. This is intentionally lightweight — outputs to feed into the Q4 pricing review and the Dedicated capacity ask.

Key assumptions (base):
- FY27 runway currency: USD.
- Base MRR run-rate: $4.2M (mid-2026 exit, used for scale ratios).
- Baseline token mix (Base): 65% text-gen, 25% embeddings, 10% reranking/other.
- Avg price per 1k tokens (Base): text-gen $0.008, embeddings $0.012, rerank $0.015.
- Average per-GPU monthly cost (amortized infra + ops): $6,800.
- Average fully-burdened engineer comp: $210k/year (~$17.5k/month). PM/DS/Customer success blended at +20% on top.
- Current FY27 HC plan (baseline product path): 64 FTEs across Eng/Prod/CS/Infra/Finance.

Simple tabular model (summarized):
Columns: Feature | Baseline HC | Delta HC (feature tilt) | Annual cost baseline | Annual cost tilted | Token mix shift | Revenue impact | Margin delta notes
Rows: personalization-ux | 6 | +10 | $1.26M | $3.5M | text-gen -> embeddings +10pp | +$0.28M rev (price premium) | higher infra / caching needed
       search-embeddings | 4 | +8 | $0.84M | $2.2M | embeddings +15pp | +$0.18M rev | heavy vector store cost, eviction
       realtime-routing | 2 | +4 | $0.42M | $1.4M | text-gen shift to lower-latency variants | -$0.05M rev | requires Dedicated for SLOs
       inferops (ops/infra) | 6 | +6 | $1.26M | $2.52M | N/A | N/A | GPU and SRE ops costs scale nonlinearly
       sales-engineering | 8 | +2 | $1.68M | $2.1M | N/A | incremental revenue TBD | GTM execution risk
Totals (headcount) | 64 | +30 -> 94 | $13.44M | $24.1M | net embeddings +20pp | revenue ± depends on price scenario | incremental infra dominates

Pricing scenarios (modeled):
- Scenario A (Base): listed prices above.
- Scenario B (Aggressive price cut - 20%): broad market pressure, per-1k tokens: text-gen $0.0064, embeddings $0.0096, rerank $0.012.
- Scenario C (Premium packaging +15% price): text-gen $0.0092, embeddings $0.0138, rerank $0.01725.
- Scenario D (Mix shift +30% embeddings demand with price pressure -10% on embeddings only): text-gen $0.008, embeddings $0.0108, rerank $0.015.

Per-scenario P&L pivots (high level):
- Base: incremental gross margin on new feature-led usage ~28% after incremental infra (approx).
- Cut-20%: unit margin falls ~6–8 percentage points; to maintain gross margin would require ~18% reduction in infra or 12% headcount freeze.
- Premium+15%: per-unit margin expands ~4–6 pp; can absorb 10% extra infra spend to deliver LLF features while maintaining overall margin.
- Mix-shift (more embeddings): CPU vs GPU footprint changes: embeddings increase vector-store and RAM/IO spend; per-unit margin tightens if embeddings price pressured.

Example sensitivity snippet (text):
- If embeddings volume increases 30% and embedding price drops 10% (Scenario D), revenue from embeddings is roughly: Delta tokens * Price -> net revenue delta = (1.30 * baseline_tokens * 0.9 * price) - baseline. In our snapshot this yields ~+7% flat revenue but ~-3% gross margin.
- If we cut prices across the board 20% (Scenario B) and do nothing else: expected FY27 gross margin drops by ~9 pp and cash burn increases by ~$2.6M on the headcount + infra plan.

Quick sensitivity table (illustrative numbers, annualized):
Scenario | Incremental HC costs | Incremental infra & ops | Net revenue delta vs Base | Net margin delta vs Base
Base     | +$10.7M              | +$4.0M                   | +$0.0M                     | 0 pp
Cut-20% | +$10.7M              | +$4.0M                   | -$1.9M                     | -9 pp
Premium+15% | +$10.7M           | +$4.4M                   | +$1.3M                     | +5 pp
Mix-embeddings | +$11.2M          | +$6.5M                   | +$0.4M                     | -3 pp

Operational levers to regain margin (ranked):
1) Batching & cache improvements (engineering): estimated 20–35% reduction in per-token infra cost for text-gen in 3–6 months — high ROI.
2) Quantization & cheaper model variants for lower-tier plans: 8–15% unit cost reduction but 2–4% quality delta risk.
3) Tiered pricing (/embeddings premium): move some high-value flows to a separate premium embedding tier; aim for +10–20% effective price for top 10% of customers.
4) Dedicated capacity offers: shift SLO-heavy customers off hosted to reserved capacity to reduce tail costs.
5) HC phasing: delay noncritical hires Q1->Q3 to smooth burn; freeze non-product hiring if scenarios B or Mix-embeddings hit.

Model caveats / unknowns:
- Customer elasticity on embeddings not well measured — current A/Bs only span small customers. Need larger cohort tests.
- Cost amortization for vector infra varies widely by region — we used blended numbers.
- Headcount productivity assumptions (per-FTE revenue delta) are rough; product-led GTM could change these materially.

Action items / next steps:
- Finance: run the detailed sheet with region-level infra unit costs (owner: Marta Li) — due 2026-11-30.
- Applied ML / Infra: feasibility quick-scan on batching + KV-store cost reductions, 2-week spike (owner: Ethan Brooks) — due 2026-12-06.
- Sales Ops: identify top-25 customers by embeddings intensity for targeted pricing pilots (owner: James O'Connor) — due 2026-12-08.
- Exec: include topline scenario chart for Q4 board packet (owner: Priya Patel) — draft due 2026-12-12.

Notes to reviewers (informal):
- This is intentionally optimistic on HC ramp being fully productive by mid-year; we should run a conservative row for 6-month productivity lag.
- If Scenario B begins to materialize in early Q1, immediate mitigation: 1) pause 50% of new feature hires; 2) accelerate batching/caching projects with contractor support.

Raw inputs and quick checks (to paste into sheet):
- Blended infra cost per token (base): $0.000012 per token (text-gen), embeddings per vector query $0.00002 baseline (very rough).
- Baseline annual tokens (product mix): 420B tokens (FY27 model).
- Expected incremental tokens from features: +48B tokens (FY27).

Owner notes: leave comments on cells F3:F12 if you disagree with per-FTE cost or the vector-store growth rate. I'm happy to split into a detailed tabbed workbook if team wants regional/BU slices.

END OF WORKBOOK SUMMARY
